Help.Portrait:
Your character at a glance.
Links to a character from this world — click the portrait to open their full sheet.
The HP bar updates in real time as damage is taken or healed.
Use the swap button to link a different character.
Help.Chronicle:
Your personal in-game diary.
Write session recaps, character thoughts, or anything your character would jot down.
Customize the look with different fonts, ink colors, and paper textures.
Pages turn with animations — use the arrows or the page corners.
Tip: try the bookplate editor to personalize the inside cover.
Help.Fellowship:
See your whole party at once.
Shows every other player character with their portrait and HP bar.
Click any portrait to open that character's sheet.
Automatically discovers characters — no setup needed.
Your own character is excluded to avoid duplicates.
Help.CompassRose:
Track your character's personal goals.
Add quests, convictions, promises, or ambitions and check them off as you go.
Click the icon on any goal to change its type.
Click the star to mark it complete.
Double-click the text to edit it.
The progress bar shows how far you've come.
Help.Scribe:
Collaborative session recaps.
Your GM creates recap prompts — you write your version of what happened.
Other players can see your recaps too (if the GM sets them as shared).
Pick an accent color to make your entries stand out.
Locked entries are read-only — the GM decides when a recap is final.
Help.DiceTray:
A quick dice roller at your fingertips.
Click dice to build a pool, then roll. Right-click to remove a die.
Add a modifier with the +/- stepper, or type a flavor note.
Pin your favorite rolls to the Quick Actions bar for one-click access.
Drag macros or items from the sidebar into the hotbar slots.
Tip: press Enter in the flavor field to roll immediately.
Help.SceneImage:
The scene's visual anchor.
Shows the background image from the linked Exalted Scene, with the scene title overlaid.
Broadcast it to your players so they see what you see.
Supports video backgrounds — they autoplay and loop.
Tip: broadcasting also triggers the scene's audio if Exalted Scenes has one set.
Help.Characters:
Your scene's cast list.
Shows every character in this scene with portrait, name, and tags.
Switch between grid and list view. Folders from Exalted Scenes carry over.
Click a portrait to dive into that character's dedicated panel.
Use the + button to add characters from the full roster.
Tip: the search bar filters by name across all folders.
Help.Paragraph:
A rich text block for narrative notes.
Click to edit using Foundry's built-in editor — bold, italic, links, all the usual tools.
Click outside or press Escape to return to reading mode.
Great for scene descriptions, read-aloud text, or GM reminders.
Tip: links in the text are clickable without entering edit mode.
Help.Teleprompter:
Read-aloud narration, scroll-style.
A compact chip on the canvas — click it to open a floating popover with your text.
Auto-scrolls at adjustable speed so you can narrate hands-free.
Customize the chip color and font size to match the mood.
Post the full text to chat as a styled narrative card.
Tip: the popover is draggable — move it wherever you need it.
Help.FreeImage:
Drop any image onto your scene canvas.
Use the file picker to select an image, then broadcast it to players with a timer.
Great for handouts, maps, illustrations, or clues you want to reveal mid-session.
Supports video files too — mp4, webm, and m4v all autoplay.
Tip: set a timer to auto-hide the broadcast after a set number of seconds.
Help.Inspiration:
Sensory cues and narrative sparks.
A compact chip — click it to open a popover full of colorful inspiration pills.
Each pill can hold a sound, smell, visual, or curiosity to improvise from.
Pick from 16 preset icon-and-color combos, or choose your own.
Tip: the popover is draggable — keep it open while you narrate.
Help.Checklist:
Track scene objectives and story beats.
A visible checklist right on the canvas — check items off as the scene progresses.
Drag the handles to reorder items. The progress bar updates live.
Click any item's text to edit it inline.
Tip: perfect for encounter phases, investigation milestones, or social goals.
Help.Divider:
A visual separator for your canvas.
Organize your widgets into logical groups with decorative lines.
6 line styles to choose from: solid, dashed, dotted, double, ornamental, and fade.
Works both horizontally and vertically.
Tip: use a custom color to match your session or beat theme.
Help.Music:
One button, one track.
Pick a track or playlist from Narrator Jukebox, then play or pause with a single click.
Each widget controls one music source — add more widgets for more tracks.
Volume slider for fine control.
Requires the Narrator Jukebox module.
Help.Ambience:
Atmosphere at a click.
Pick an ambience track or saved preset from Narrator Jukebox.
Play, pause, and adjust volume from a minimalist circular button.
Use the tabs to switch between individual tracks and saved presets.
Requires the Narrator Jukebox module.
Help.Soundboard:
Fire-and-forget sound effects.
Pick a sound from Narrator Jukebox, then click to fire it instantly — no sustained playback.
Perfect for door slams, thunder cracks, or dramatic stingers.
Each widget is one sound — scatter several across your canvas for a full soundboard.
Requires the Narrator Jukebox module.
Help.Timer:
Countdown and stopwatch for the table.
Choose from presets (30s to 30m) or enter a custom duration.
Broadcast the timer to players — they see a live HUD on their screen.
Works as a stopwatch too if you need to count up instead.
Tip: the progress ring fills as time passes, giving everyone a visual cue.
Help.Sticky:
Quick post-it notes on the canvas.
Always editable — just start typing. No edit mode, no fuss.
Pick from 6 colors: yellow, pink, blue, green, orange, or purple.
Use them for reminders, improv hooks, or things you don't want to forget mid-session.
Tip: scatter several around your canvas — they're lightweight by design.
Help.ProgressClock:
Blades-in-the-Dark-style progress clocks.
Track threats, countdowns, or long-term projects with visual segments.
Multiple clocks per widget — add as many as you need.
Three styles: pie, dots, or bar. Progress or countdown mode.
Broadcast individual clocks to players.
Tip: link clocks together — when one fills, the next starts automatically.
Help.Faction:
Track reputation with a faction.
13 levels from Hunted to Exalted, with customizable labels and colors.
Add characters as members with individual notes and reputation sliders.
Upload a banner image with the file picker.
Save factions to the library to reuse them across scenes.
Tip: each faction gets its own widget — use several for a political web.
Help.TimeTracker:
Count abstract in-game time.
Track turns, hours, watches, days — whatever unit your game needs.
Three ring styles: Arc (progress fill), Sundial (tick marks), Pulse (atmospheric glow).
Customize color, add a center icon, and a badge label for personality.
Broadcast to players with a persistent HUD, or flash for dramatic moments.
Optional secondary counter with auto-conversion (e.g. 6 Turns = 1 Day).
Tip: this tracks narrative time, not real-world time — you control every tick.
Help.JournalBoard:
Quick access to your key journal entries.
Pin Foundry journals, specific pages, or even individual headings.
Switch between card and list views. Search across titles and content.
Click any entry to open it in Foundry's journal viewer.
Tip: great for lore references, NPC dossiers, or session handouts you need on hand.
Help.MacroPad:
Your scene's macro shortcuts.
Drag macros straight from Foundry's sidebar into the grid.
Click to execute instantly. Drag to reorder.
The grid adapts from 1 to 3 columns based on widget width.
Tip: use the dropdown picker to add macros if you prefer browsing over dragging.
Help.SceneLink:
Link a native Foundry scene to your canvas.
Shows the scene thumbnail and name — click to activate it in one step.
Great for tying Foundry's scene system to your SessionFlow layout.
Tip: drag a scene from Foundry's sidebar directly into the widget.
Help.Relationships:
Map how this character feels about others.
13 sentiment levels from Nemesis to Bonded, each with its own color.
Click a level to set it — no dragging needed. Add notes per relationship.
Characters come from the Exalted Scenes roster.
Tip: this widget only appears in the character panel — it's personal to each character.
Help.DayNight:
A living sky that tracks the time of day.
The gradient and sun/moon arc follow Foundry's world time in real time.
Advance or retreat time with the buttons — this actually changes world time for all modules.
Broadcast the sky to players as a draggable HUD.
Tip: click the clock to type a specific time directly.
Help.Sequence:
Control an Exalted Scenes sequence.
Browse through a scene's backgrounds with hero-image crossfades and a filmstrip.
Click thumbnails or use the arrows to advance. The counter tracks your position.
Requires an Exalted Scene with multiple backgrounds.
Tip: the filmstrip glows with the current beat's color for visual context.
Help.Slideshow:
Control an Exalted Scenes slideshow.
Play, pause, skip, and scrub through auto-playing scene sequences.
Shows the current slide name and number with a progress bar.
Loop and shuffle toggles for presentation flexibility.
Requires the Exalted Scenes module.
Help.Map:
A tactical map board with markers.
Upload multiple maps, then place icon or text markers anywhere.
Pan and zoom from 0.25× to 4× magnification. Overlay a configurable grid with scale bar.
Broadcast the current view to your players.
Tip: right-click a marker to edit its label, icon, color, or size.
Help.QuestTracker:
Full quest management for your campaign.
Create quests with objectives, rewards, and status tracking (hidden, active, completed, failed).
Mark objectives as secret — only you see them until you choose to reveal.
Broadcast active quests to players. Auto-posts to chat on completion or failure.
Save quest sets to the library for reuse.
Tip: drag objectives to reorder them within a quest.
Help.Currency:
Party wealth tracking and management.
Choose a preset currency system (D&D 5e, Pathfinder, Modern, Cyberpunk) or define custom currencies.
Link characters to Foundry actors for automatic wealth sync.
Split loot, transfer funds, convert between currencies, and log every transaction.
Broadcast the treasury to players.
Tip: save your currency setup to the library so you can reuse it across scenes.
Help.CastDisplay:
Show characters without a scene background.
Controls Exalted Scenes' Cast Only mode — ideal for dialogue, theater-of-the-mind, or battlemaps.
Pick position, size, and shape presets for the character display.
Broadcast to players with live sync.
Requires the Exalted Scenes module.
Tip: changes here sync bidirectionally — edits in Exalted Scenes reflect here too.
Help.QuickScenes:
One-click scene shortcuts.
Pin scenes from any beat in any session for instant cross-beat navigation.
Each chip shows the scene title with the beat's color for context.
Drag to reorder. Click to jump immediately.
Tip: use the hierarchical picker to browse sessions → beats → scenes.
